mapper.sql: id, content, sp_id, status, remark, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ink_signature (content, sp_id, status, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{content}, #{spId}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE ink_signature SET content = #{content}, sp_id = #{spId}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ink_signature SET status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
